name: VexTextureWork
observations: Tripo AI knight model with chaotic non-mirrored UV atlas
AO-inverse delighting V3 at 65% strength was the winning formula
NEVER apply broad image filters to whole texture atlas - catastrophic artifacts
Skin mask via HSV + LAB a-channel (132-160) isolates 9.7% of atlas for selective smoothing
PBR maps generated: normal (Sobel 2.0), roughness, metallic, AO all at 4096x4096
Working dir: Tools/temp/vex_texture_work/
Unity textures at: Assets/Resources/Art/Textures/Characters/Vex/

name: Vex_Character
observations: VeilBreakers Ironbound Tank character
Original was Tripo AI generated: 21k verts, single mesh, single material, triangle soup
Being re-exported from Tripo with improved retopology and segmentation Feb 2026
Has Auto Rig Pro armature in Blender (381 bones)
Previous problems: armor deformation, beard penetration, no facial animation, anchored hands
Mesh name in Blender was: tripo_mesh_6f7e62ce_896b_4161_ac05_a758db6725d7
Needs proper edge loops at joints, face, for animation to work
Lion chest emblem must be rigid (single bone weight)
Has 3-bone goatee beard chain (beard_tie_01-03.x)
New Tripo export comes SEGMENTED - multiple mesh pieces not one solid mesh
Strategy: keep rigid pieces separate (armor, accessories), join deformable pieces (skin, cloth)
Separate rigid meshes = single bone weight per piece = zero deformation problems
Separate beard mesh = no more weight bleeding into chest armor
Need to visually assess each segment and decide join vs keep before rigging
Too many separate objects = more draw calls in Unity, so be strategic about it

name: Blender_Workflow_Rules
observations: ALWAYS use get_viewport_screenshot before and after edits
Check from multiple angles: front, side, 3/4, back
Use weight paint MODE visually, not just script weight assignment
Use pose mode to TEST deformation before declaring done
Use Graph Editor for animation curves, NLA for clip management
Rigid armor = single bone at 1.0 weight, verify in weight paint view
For face: shape keys may work better than bones if topology lacks face loops
Check wireframe topology at joints/face before rigging
Report findings honestly - don't pretend things are working
FULL TOOLKIT AVAILABLE - 32 sculpt brushes, 16 weight paint tools, 162 mesh ops
Key sculpt brushes for character work: Snake Hook (pull/deform), Pose (pose while sculpting), Cloth (drape cloth), Grab, Elastic Deform, Smooth
Key weight paint tools: Blur (smooth weight transitions), Gradient (linear weight falloff), Normalize All, Transfer Weights, Fix Deforms
Key mesh ops: Loop Cut & Slide (add edge loops), Bridge Edge Loops (connect pieces), Knife Tool, Poly Build (retopo), Fill Grid
Key deform modifiers: Corrective Smooth (fix deformation artifacts), Surface Deform, Hook, Lattice, Shrinkwrap
Physics available: Cloth sim for beard/straps (bake to keyframes for game), Collision, Soft Body
Hair Curves system available in Blender 5.0
Geometry Nodes with simulation zones available
USE THESE VISUAL TOOLS not just Python scripts
